arm.name: Arm
arm.description: Arm an Alarmo entity with custom settings.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Alarm entity (partition) that should be armed.

code.name: Code
code.description: Code to use for the arming.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Alarm panel mode to arm the partition in.

force.name: Force
force.description: Automatically bypass all zones that prevent the arming operation.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Alarm entity (partition) that should be disarmed.

code.name: Code
code.description: Code to use for the disarming.

skip_delay.name: Skip Delay
skip_delay.description: Skip the remainder of the exit/entry delay and proceed directly to the next state. Only has effect whilst the alarm is in arming or pending state.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Alarm entity for which the delay should be skipped.

enable_user.name: Enable User
enable_user.description: Allow a user to arm/disarm alarmo.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the user to enable.

disable_user.name: Disable User
disable_user.description: Block a user from arming/disarming alarmo.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the user to disable.

create_backup.name: Create backup
create_backup.description: Write a date-stamped backup of the Alarmo configuration (an exact copy of .storage/alarmo.storage plus a YAML export) to /config/alarmo/backups. The files contain hashed user codes.

label.name: Label
label.description: Optional short label added to the file name, for example 'nightly'.

set_house_mode.name: Set House Mode
set_house_mode.description: Change the Alarmo House Mode. Alarmo checks who may change the mode (source), whether zones are ready, arms/disarms the partitions and retries; lifestyle actions stay in your automations (trigger on alarmo_house_mode_changed or select.alarmo_house_mode).

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Name or id of the House Mode.

source.name: Source
source.description: Who is asking, for the permission table: schedule, presence_away, presence_home, lock, ... Default: manual if a user called it, else automation.

force.name: Force
force.description: Ignore the permission table and readiness checks.
